name: button
title: Button
avoidFor: Icon-only actions without an accessible name

composition.brutalismGeometry: The default rounded shape resolves to rounded-none in Brutalism; pill, FAB, and consumer radius classes remain deliberate overrides.
composition.fabBehavior: Render a square, circular, padding-free icon action on the shared 32px, 36px, 40px, and 48px application scale, with an intentional 72px 2xl display tier and proportionally sized icons; consumers own floating placement and must provide an accessible name.
composition.loadingBehavior: Disable interaction, expose aria-busy, and replace the leading icon with a spinner.
composition.neutralColor: Neutral is the chrome color: a filled neutral action uses the inverse pair and every quieter treatment resolves to the plain foreground, so toolbar and shell controls do not compete with the content they frame.

accessibility: Provide visible text or an accessible name.
FAB-shaped icon-only actions require an accessible name.
Loading and disabled states must block interaction and not rely only on color.
commonMistakes: Creating a clickable div instead of Button.
Using outline when a lower-contrast translucent glass action is intended.
Putting visible text inside a FAB-shaped button or omitting its accessible name.

examples.title: Soft
examples.description: Use the soft variant for a low-emphasis action with a palette-tinted fill.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button variant="soft">button</Button>
</template>

examples.title: Outline
examples.description: Use the outline variant when the action needs a visible semantic boundary.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button variant="outline" color="secondary">button</Button>
</template>

examples.title: Glass
examples.description: Use the glass variant for a translucent action with a restrained rim.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button variant="glass" :prefix-icon="undefined">button</Button>
</template>

examples.title: Large pill
examples.description: Combine the large size, pill shape, and an optional icon.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
import { ArrowRight } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button size="lg" shape="pill" :prefix-icon="ArrowRight">button</Button>
</template>

examples.title: 2XL floating action button
examples.description: Use the 2XL FAB for a display-level 72px icon action with an accessible label.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
import { Plus } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button size="2xl" shape="fab" :prefix-icon="Plus" aria-label="Add placeholder" />
</template>

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: Loading preserves the action label while blocking interaction.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button loading>button</Button>
</template>

examples.title: Destructive
examples.description: Reserve the destructive color for consequential actions.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button color="destructive" :prefix-icon="undefined">Action placeholder</Button>
</template>

examples.title: Custom analytics event
examples.description: Emit a deliberate business event in addition to the structural interaction when Analytics is installed.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button analytics-event="cta">Start now</Button>
</template>
